historical_forecast.reason: Original forecast is a historical planning reserve. Fixed31 has since passed. Other work may already be included in the later quota baseline; no exact completion/occupancy deduction is invented.

capacity_scenario.limits: This preserves the full historical reserve and can double-count completed work already in the baseline. Future test cache, unindexed logs/gate/metadata, source bundles, filesystem allocation overhead and unbounded retries are not measured.
